summary: Warren County lookout with 1934 county and Forest Service funding; removed at an unknown date, a ground structure remains; a 2024 visit found no tower.

facts.design: Standard four-legged tower about 60 feet tall, per a 1957 USGS description
facts.status_note: Removed at an unknown date; a ground structure remains. No source gives the removal date.

access.note: Register lists a private owner as administrator; no source says the summit is open to visitors

visit.trail_note: A side trail with 136 feet of gain leads up from the Appalachian Trail. A 2024 visit found no tower on the summit.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The register and the state list place the site in Warren County. The Willhite page lists the summit in both Fauquier (county highpoint) and Warren counties. The story reports both.

notes_for_editor: Two web searches found no removal date. The Willhite page is the only source for the ground structure and the 2024 visit; its photo captions are quoted only as captions. The 1934 items are funding, not a confirmed completion date. The 1948 in the FFLOS id is a registry number, not a build year, and is not used. Height 18.3 m converts the 1957 description of about 60 feet. The 1934 Forest Service observations are from the Willhite page. No photos added; the 2025 photo credit on the Willhite page has no license stated.
